method: High at fixed 0.75 cloud scale, 1000 x 625 DPR2. Shared helper replaced in view, illumination and ground shadow materials. Two mirrored runs, 24 warm / 40 timed frames. Local exploratory timing, not endurance.
disposition: Rejected for production: all tested displayed frames match, but short local GPU timings show no stable improvement beyond run variation. Runtime shader remains unchanged.
